instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a pipelined 100-bit left/right rotator with synchronous load and left/right enable. The module should implement the rotator using a barrel shifter and a multiplexer, and should shift-in the shifted-out bit from the other end of the register. 
When enabled, the rotator should rotate the bits around and not modify/discard them. Use pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
